gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_10.$value: Setiap transaksi bantu kamu dapet star.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_12.$value: Kumpulin star buat dapetin benefit eksklusif!

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_14.$value: Program loyalty yang bikin kamu dapet benefit spesial dari aktivitas harianmu di Gojek.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_18.$value: Kamu bisa cek benefit selengkapnya di app Gojek.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_22.$value: Kalo ada issue, bantuan untukmu diprioritasin.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_25.$value: Cek lebih banyak voucher di Gojek app

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_26.$value:
Makasih udah jadi pelanggan setia GoTo! Kamu terpilih buat nyobain GoStar, program loyalti terbaru kami.
 
Setiap pakai Gojek atau GoPay, kamu bisa dapetin 2 jenis star. Status Star bakal bantu kamu naik level. Reward Star bisa kamu tukar dengan macem-macem benefit menarik, misalnya voucher.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_28.$value: Apa itu GoStar dan gimana cara kerjanya?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_29.$value: Reward Stars bisa dituker voucher GoCar, GoFood, dan lainnya di Katalog Reward. Kalau naik level, kamu bakal dapetin benefit eksklusif sesuai level, seperti Priority Help, FREE Faster Search, dan lainnya.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_30.$value: Ada 4 level di GoStar: Member, New Star, Rising Star, dan Superstar (level paling tinggi!). Status Star yang kamu dapetin kalau pakai Gojek atau GoPay, bakal bantu kamu naik level.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_31.$value: GoStar ada berapa level? Gimana cara naik levelnya?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_32.$value: Apa aja reward dan benefit yang saya dapat?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_33.$value: Pastiin Gojek-mu udah versi 5.45.1 buat akses GoStar.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_34.$value: Status Star dan Reward Star punya siklus per 3 bulan (kuartal). Status Star yang kamu dapetin dalam satu kuartal bakal kadaluarsa pada hari pertama kuartal berikutnya. Reward Star berlaku selama 2 kuartal (6 bulan) dan bakal kadaluarsa di akhir kuartal kedua.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_35.$value: Kapan Status Star dan Reward Star kadaluarsa?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_36.$value: Lihat semua infonya di Gojek app

Note: Q: Initially I'm proposing "Use Coins" bcs it's the most straightforward & neutral copy we can go with. But after discussing it in payments copy review, it is suggested that we should consider going with "Use now" (to emphasize urgency) or "Use all" (to hint coins all-in usage mechanism). Which will be the better option? Update: Upon testing a couple of users, they agree that "Use now" will emphasize urgency. However, they came up with follow up question "Use what now?" On the other hand, "Use all" seems to be the most confusing alternative for users bcs they're not sure what we mean by all. Is it all expiring Coins? Is it all Coins balance they have? Or is it all payment methods? This confusion also shown by a regular Coins user. While for "Use Coins", they're response is that they can understand easily that whatever happens, their Coins will be used once they tapped on the CTA. They don't need to think about how much will it be used or does it refers to another pay method. Hence, I'd suggest we still go with "Use Coins".
